text: 科创50指数半日涨3.45%，算力硬件、芯片股集体走强。 恒指半日跌0.4%，恒生科技指数涨0.2%，智谱涨近9%，百度涨超6%。 中国7月规模以上工业企业利润同比增长11.2%，1-7月集成电路行业利润同比增长18.5倍。 王毅会见美国驻华大使庞德伟。 A股审核真相！未盈利企业IPO收紧？媒体援引知情人士：不封堵只提质。 韩国央行连续第二次会议加息，大幅上调今明两年经济增长预期。 报道称英伟达129亿美元收购Hugging Face，AI”中间层”争夺战全面打响。 智谱新模型“牛来”跑在10万国产卡上，SemiAnalaysis评价“英伟达护城河再受考
text_en: STAR 50 Index rose 3.45% by midday, with computing hardware and chip stocks rallying collectively. Hang Seng Index fell 0.4% by midday, Hang Seng Tech Index rose 0.2%, Zhipu rose nearly 9%, Baidu gained over 6%. China's July industrial enterprise profits rose 11.2% YoY; January-July integrated circuit industry profits surged 18.5 times YoY. Wang Yi met with US Ambassador to China Nicholas Burns. A-share audit truth! Tightening IPOs for unprofitable companies? Media citing insiders: not blocking, only improving quality. Bank of Korea raised rates for the second consecutive meeting, sharply upgrading growth forecasts for this year and next. Reports say Nvidia acquires Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, igniting an all-out battle for AI 'middle layer'. Zhipu's new model 'Niulai' runs on 100,000 domestic chips; SemiAnalysis says 'Nvidia's moat faces another test'
